summary: Tested iteration 271: Offline Everywhere (Breathwork + Grounding + Meditation regression + offline playback/delete), Streak Reminder settings + watcher suppression path, and Journey Milestone Blessing. All backend endpoints pass. All frontend flows work EXCEPT the MilestoneBlessing full-screen overlay is trapped inside the SacredJourneyWidget (not full-screen). Root cause: backdrop-filter on parent widget establishes a containing block for position:fixed descendants. Total 2 offline downloads performed (1 breathwork, 1 grounding), 11 TTS calls total.

ui_bugs.issue: Overlay declared as 'fixed inset-0 z-[300]' does NOT cover viewport — it is contained within the 1102x322 SacredJourneyWidget card. Root cause: SacredJourneyWidget's outer div uses `backdrop-blur-xl` (backdrop-filter: blur(24px)), which per CSS spec establishes a NEW containing block for position:fixed descendants. Measured overlay rect: {x:297, y:407, w:1102, h:322} on 1440x900 viewport; ancestors_creating_containing_block detected: [{testid:'sacred-journey-widget', backdropFilter:'blur(24px)'}]. Result: milestone visually appears inside the widget card, 'Receive the Blessing' button may sit below fold, dismiss button hit-testing works via JS but user experience is broken. Fix: render <MilestoneBlessing> either (a) as a React Portal to document.body, or (b) lift it out of SacredJourneyWidget and mount it inside Dashboard root outside any backdrop-filter ancestor.

issues: Copy still reads 'Open Meditations and tap the download icon on any practice to keep it with you offline.' — should mention Breathwork and Grounding now that they support offline download too.

critical_code_review_comments: MilestoneBlessing rendered inside a `backdrop-blur-xl` ancestor breaks its own position:fixed layout — this is a subtle CSS containing-block bug (same class of gotcha as `transform` on parents). Prefer portals for full-screen overlays.

StreakReminderWatcher good pattern: calls localStorage.setItem('streakReminderLastShown', today) BEFORE the practicedToday early-return so the reminder fires at most once per day even when suppressed — verified working.
useOfflineDownload disables all other download buttons while one is in progress via `disabled={Boolean(downloadingId) && !isDownloading}` — good UX guard, verified.

SacredJourneyWidget still uses `/api/practice-history/stats` while the top 'Practice Streak' widget on Dashboard uses a different (user_progress) source — with 7 seeded practice_history entries this iteration, Journey correctly shows 7-day streak / 14 practices but the top strip still shows '0 days'. Data-source mismatch remains from iteration_270 — worth unifying.

rca_of_the_issue: MilestoneBlessing overlay is not full-screen. It uses className='fixed inset-0 z-[300]…' correctly. However, its containing block is NOT the viewport because its closest ancestor (SacredJourneyWidget's outer div, data-testid='sacred-journey-widget') has `backdrop-filter: blur(24px)` (Tailwind `backdrop-blur-xl`). Per CSS Containment / Backdrop-filter spec, any non-none `filter`, `backdrop-filter`, `transform`, `perspective`, `contain: paint`, or `will-change: transform` on an ancestor establishes a NEW containing block for fixed-positioned descendants, effectively turning `position: fixed` into `position: absolute` relative to that ancestor. Reproduction: login QA user, clear localStorage.journeyMilestoneCelebrated_7, visit /dashboard with current_streak>=7. Overlay measures ~1102x322 anchored at top-left (297,407) of the widget, not the viewport. Mitigation options: (a) React portal — createPortal(<MilestoneBlessing/>, document.body) — cleanest; (b) render <MilestoneBlessing streak={stats.current_streak}/> from Dashboard.jsx directly (outside any backdrop-blur wrapper) instead of from inside SacredJourneyWidget; (c) remove `backdrop-blur-xl` from SacredJourneyWidget's outer div (loses visual effect).
